rules.title: How mentoring works

steps.find: Find an alumni who is open to mentoring and open their profile.
steps.explain: Choose a topic and explain what you'd like help with ({min} to {max} characters).
steps.answer: They accept or decline: you get a notification either way.
steps.contact: Once they accept, you both see each other's e-mail address to continue the conversation.

rules.limits: Up to {max} pending requests at a time, and one per alumni.

ask.topicHint: In a few words, e.g. "Final-year internship".
ask.messageHint: Introduce yourself and say what you'd like help with: {min} to {max} characters ({count}/{max}).
ask.privacy: {name} sees your name, your topic and your message. Your e-mail address is shared only if they accept.
ask.sent: Request sent. You'll get a notification when they answer.
ask.offline: You're offline: you can send a request when you're back online.
ask.pendingShort: Your request is waiting for {name}'s answer.
ask.unavailable: {name} isn't taking mentoring requests right now.
ask.limitText: You already have {max} pending requests. Wait for an answer or withdraw one before asking someone else.
ask.previousDeclined: {name} declined your last request. You can send a new one.
ask.previousClosed: Your last request to {name} is closed. You can send a new one.
ask.pendingInfo: {count, plural, =0 {You have no pending request.} one {You have # of {max} pending requests.} other {You have # of {max} pending requests.}}

support.title: All alumni profiles
support.intro: Every profile, private ones included, to help alumni with their account. Never share private profiles.
support.notSavedText: This list is never saved on the device: connect to the internet to see it.

profile.notAvailable: {name} isn't taking mentoring requests right now.

form.title: Edit my profile
form.pathIntro: What you do today and where you studied. Your e-mail address is never shown on your profile.
form.headline: Headline
form.headlineHint: One line that sums you up, e.g. "Data scientist at Carthage Data Lab".
form.bioHint: Your path, what you enjoy, what you can share ({count}/{max}).
form.skillsHint: Press Enter after each skill. Up to {max}.
form.mentoringIntro: Students can ask you for advice. You accept or decline each request.
form.mentoringOnText: Students can send you requests on the topics below.
form.mentoringOffText: Students can't send you new requests.
form.topicsHint: Press Enter after each topic ({min} to {maxLength} characters). Up to {max}.
form.offline: You're offline: you can save when you're back online.

visibility.title: Visibility and consent
visibility.visibleStatus: Your profile is visible to the campus.
visibility.visibleText: Signed-in students, teachers and alumni can find you in the directory and ask you for mentoring. You gave your consent on {date}.
visibility.withdrawHint: You can withdraw your consent at any time.
visibility.privateText: Only you (and the administrators, for support) can see it. Students can't find you in the directory.
visibility.consentLabel: I agree that CampusLink shows my alumni profile (name, path, skills, mentoring topics and posts) to signed-in members of the campus.
visibility.consentHint: Your e-mail address stays hidden. You can withdraw this consent at any time.
visibility.consentMissing: Tick the box to give your consent first.
visibility.nowVisible: Your profile is now visible to the campus.

data.exportText: A JSON file with everything stored about you in the alumni network: your profile, your posts and your mentoring requests.
data.offline: You're offline: this needs a connection.
data.eraseIntro: You can ask CampusLink to forget you in the alumni network:

effects.requests: Your open mentoring requests are closed and the students are told.
effects.history: Your name and your messages are removed from past mentoring requests.
effects.account: Your CampusLink account stays: you can create a new profile later.

data.dialogText: Your profile and posts are deleted and your mentoring history is anonymized. Download your data first if you want to keep a copy.
data.erased: Your alumni data was deleted. Your account stays: you can create a new profile at any time.
